_comment: Web implementation of the Barnes Brand (Design System artifact 'Barnes Brand', v1, November 2026). Values match docs/assets/css/site.css. Replaces mla-palette-barnes-pllc.json (Barnes PLLC identity layer on MLA, October 2026).
name: Barnes Brand: jtbarnespllc.com
does_not_apply_to: formal legal documents (Times New Roman, black)
principle: One word, one mark, three colors (Ink, White, Rust), one typeface (Libre Franklin).

zones.firm: Client-facing pages. White header and content, surface-alt page heroes, Night home hero, CTA band and footer.
zones.lab: Insights, newsletter, practice tools. Same tokens; a stone hero and surface-alt ground mark the zone.

tokens.role: Page heroes, alternate sections, Lab ground
Lab hero, Lab band. Never a text color
Form field borders (web addition for 3:1 non-text contrast)
The corner, thin rules, focus ring, highlighted headline word. Text only at 18px and above. Never a large fill
Home hero, CTA band, footer, practice aside, Lab mockups, Timekeeper bar
Raised surface on night (surface-alt, dark theme)

typography.family: Libre Franklin 400, 400 italic, 500, 600, 700, 800 (self-hosted woff2, SIL Open Font License)
typography.labels: 600, 0.74rem, capitals, letter-spacing 0.14em, ink-muted, led by a 22px rust rule
typography.wordmark: Supplied artwork only (assets/img/brand/*.svg). Do not retype in a font.

motif.closing_corner: One per page, at the end of the page headline (h1), in place of the final period; other end punctuation stays. 0.26em square, 0.12em arms, tucked 0.10em back, bottom 0.16em below the baseline. Rust on light, copper on night. Generated by closing() in build/build.py.
motif.radius: Square everywhere; 2px on buttons and fields; circles for the headshot only.
